Portfolio & resources

Projects

Autonomous Yahtzee agent — a Monte-Carlo Tree Search agent that plays Yahtzee, fully in-browser. Adversary and assistant modes, plus a full technical report (MDP, MCTS, experimental design & statistics).

Play · Report · Code (JS)

Option pricer (binomial tree) — CRR pricing engine for European/American options (calls & puts) on stocks, indices, currencies and futures. An interactive web version runs entirely in the browser, with reference tests against Hull & Black-Scholes.

Online pricer · Code (Python)

TS Proxy — implementation of an HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy server with extra features: white/blacklist management and basic DDoS countermeasures.
